snippet.title: Locked out, grilling indoors, and both rescuers douse the victim 🧯 #shorts  #comedy  #funny
snippet.description:
a far trip for a grill, a locked door, an indoor barbecue — and two rescuers with terrible aim.

The grill trip — Ollie complains: Jax, we ran that far just to buy this thing — what is it even for? Jax: what do you know, this is a barbecue grill — later I am treating you all to BBQ. Ollie: really? Jax: yes. Then Jesse brakes hard, and Jax's head smacks straight into the vehicle's baffle. Jax: can you even drive? Jesse: Jax, we are home. Jax: fine, get out. 🍖

The lost key — At the front door, Jax keeps rummaging through pockets. Ollie: Jax, why aren't you opening the door? Jax: how do I open it without a key? Ollie: then where is the key? Jax: I seem to have dropped it inside the house. Ollie: so what do we do? Jax: only one way — climb over the wall. 🧱

The wall and the grill — The scene shifts: Jesse holds Jax up as Jax climbs over the wall. Jesse: Jax, hurry up. Jax: what is there to panic about, I am climbing. Jax makes it in. Jesse: Jax, take the grill — and hurls the barbecue grill over the wall, followed immediately by Jax's scream. Ollie: something happened! In the panic, Ollie gives the door a push — and it swings right open. Ollie: the door was not even locked! Out walks Jax, clutching the head that just took the grill to it, in time to see the whole scene: are you two insane? 🚪

The indoor finale — Ollie: what happened? Jax: the sun is blazing — don't you two feel hot eating BBQ out here? Ollie: good point — where else then? Jax: follow me, we eat inside. Jesse: Jax, are you sure grilling here is safe? Jax: what could be unsafe? Jesse: there is a gas tank right behind you. Ollie: yeah, there is. Jesse: what if it explodes? Ollie: right, what if? Jax: impossible, absolutely impossible — you two just wait for your BBQ. An explosion rings out; all three bolt out. Jax: quick! Bring water to put out the fire! Jesse dumps a full bucket of water — square onto Jax. Ollie rushes over with another — the water is coming! — and that bucket lands on Jax too. 🧯
